page: Amazon Web Services m8id.24xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 96 vCPUs consisting of 48 physical cores with 2 threads per core running at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, supported by a 480 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 384 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing 4 GB of RAM per core. It includes 5700 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps, running on the Nitro hypervisor.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates top-tier performance in multi-threaded operations and memory bandwidth. It achieves top-tier status in Geekbench multi-core scores, software compilation, and ray tracing. Memory read-only bandwidth for both small and large blocks ranks in the top 10 percent, while large block writes are rated as strong. The processor advanced instruction support, including AVX-512 and AMX, contributes to top-tier scores in Passmark extended instructions, encryption, and database operations. Single-core performance is moderate, with stress-ng single-core benchmarks falling in the average range, though multi-core CPU performance remains strong.

The combination of high-density DDR5 memory, massive local NVMe SSD storage, and advanced CPU instructions makes this instance highly cost-efficient for resource-intensive deployments without requiring dedicated GPU hardware. It is particularly well-suited for large-scale database operations, Redis deployments, static web serving, and multi-threaded software compilation. Additionally, the presence of AMX instructions enables efficient LLM inference prompt processing, where it achieves top-tier token processing speeds for small, medium, and large models.
